A bounded scan of both canonical project data roots found zero execution-like files whose paths identify AWM/WebArena financial trajectories, LiteralPort/NoEnvelope rollouts, native function-call records, or matched result manifests. Current Generator/Search-Portfolio text mentions these controls but is search output, not independent support truth. Constructing synthetic trajectories, inventing envelope outcomes, or writing a candidate-specific executor would violate the frozen anti-substitution and independent-truth contract.
rows.reopen_only_if: Reopen when first-party released artifacts or another already provenance-audited substrate materialize the same frozen AWM/WebArena skill content under at least three semantically equivalent envelope realizations and a native function-calling executor with per-unit tool/argument/output records, matched held-out states, null-memory/history controls, and independent task truth. The materialization must freeze the operationalization before outcome readout and may not use synthetic substitution, candidate-mechanism injection, candidate-pool changes, or hidden-outcome retuning.
